learned: A rollback command succeeding is insufficient; only exact version observation permits durable custody consumption, while pending or wrong-version states must leave the retained identity eligible.
next_action: Exercise one uninstall→exact rollback chain in an Extension Development Host, retain the pre-uninstall identity, absence, exact reinstall, restored version, and consumed-custody evidence, and preserve custody if the host cannot restore the target.

evidence.claim: PX905 exact rollback implementation consumes only verified custody.
